preconditions.description: The number of nodes n and queries q are within the specified bounds.
The number of edges is exactly 2n - 2, where n is the number of nodes.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(ai) <= int(n) and 1 <= int(bi) <= int(n) and 1 <= int(ci) <= 10**6 for ai, bi, ci in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge (ai, bi) has valid node labels between 1 and n, and weight ci between 1 and 10^6.

preconditions.expression: all(bi == 1 for ai, bi, ci in edges[n-1:])
preconditions.description: The last n - 1 edges all point to node 1.

preconditions.expression: all(ai != bi for ai, bi, ci in edges[:n-1])
preconditions.description: The first n - 1 edges form a spanning tree (no self-loops).

preconditions.expression: all(ai != 1 for ai, bi, ci in edges[n-1:])
preconditions.description: The last n - 1 edges originate from nodes other than 1.

preconditions.expression: all(ai != aj for ai, bi, ci in edges[n-1:] for aj, bj, cj in edges[n-1:] if ai != aj)
preconditions.description: The last n - 1 edges have distinct source nodes (2 to n).

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line.strip() == '0' if u == v else (stdout_line.strip().isdigit() and int(stdout_line.strip()) >= 0) for stdout_line in stdout_lines if stdout_line.strip() != '')
postconditions.description: For each type 2 query (u, v), the output is either 0 if u == v, or a non-negative integer representing the shortest path length from u to v.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout_line.strip()) == min(sum(weights) for path in all_paths(u, v) for weights in path_weights(path)) if u != v else 0 for stdout_line, (u, v) in zip(stdout_lines, type2_queries))
postconditions.description: For each type 2 query (u, v), the output is the length of the shortest path from u to v, where the path is computed using the current edge weights.
